definitions.short: properly, to hie for refuge (but not so precipitately as 2620 ); figuratively, to trust , be confident or sure
definitions.usage: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.
definitions.full: H982. batach I. בָּטַח verb trust (compare Arabic to throw one down upon his face Thes, lie extended on the ground , 'se reposer sur quelqu' un' Fl MV) — Qal Perfect בָּטַח Psa 28:7 35t.; Imperfect יִבְּטַח Job 40:23 27t.; Imperative בְּטַח Psa 37:3 8 t.; Infinitive abs בָּטוֺחַ Isa 59:4 , construct בְּטֹחַ Psa 118:8 2 t.; Participle בֹּטֵחַ 21:8 35t.; passive בָּטוּחַ 112:7 ; Isa 26:3 . I. trust. 1 absolute Isa 12:2 . 2 with cognate accusative בטחת אשׁר הזה הבטחון מה what is this trust that thou dost trust ? 2Kin 18:19 = Isa 36:4 . 3 with בְּ trust in — a. God 2Kin 18:5 ; 19:10 ; 1Chr 5:20 ; Psa 9:11 ; 21:8 ; 22:5 ; 22:6 ; 25:2 ; 26:1 ; 28:7 ; 32:10 ; 37:3 ; 40:4 ; Psalm 55:24; 56:5 ; 56:12 ; 62:9 ; Psalm 84:13; 91:2 ; 112:7 ; 115:9 ; 115:10 ; 115:11 ; 125:1 ; 143:8 ; Prov 16:20 ; 29:25 ; Isa 26:3-4 , 37:10 ; Jer 17:7 ; 39:18 ; Zeph 3:2 . b. persons Judg 9:26 ; Psa 41:10 ; 118:8 ; 118:9 ; 146:3 ; Prov 31:11 ; Jer 17:5 ; 46:25 ; Micah 7:5 . c. things Deut 28:32 ; Job 39:11 ; Psa 27:3 ; 44:7 ; 52:9 ; 62:11 ; 115:8 ; 135:18 ; Prov 11:28 ; 28:26 ; Isa 30:12 ; 42:17 ; 47:10 ; Jer 5:17 ; 7:14 ; 12:5 ; 13:25 ; 48:7 ; 49:4 ; Ezek 16:15 ; Hosea 10:13 ; Amos 6:1 . d. in the name of Gos Psalm Amos 33:21; Isa 5:10 ; mercy of God Psa 13:6 ; Psalm 52:10; word of God 119:42 ; salvation of God 78:22 . 4 with עַל , trust or rely upon — a. God Psa 31:15 ; 37:5 ; Prov 28:25 ; Jer 49:11 . b. persons 2Kin 18:20-21 , 24 = Isa 36:5 ; 36:6 ; 36:9 ; Jer 9:3 . c. things 2Kin 18:21 = Isa 36:6 ; 2Chr 32:10 ; Psa 49:7 ; Isa 31:1 ; 59:4 ; Ezek 33:13 ; Hab 2:18 . 5 with אֶל trust to — a. God 2Kin 18:22 (= Isa 36:7 ) Psa 4:6 ; 31:7 ; 56:4 ; 86:2 ; Prov 3:5 . b. persons Judg 20:36 . c. things Jer 7:4 (= דבר על 7:8 ). II. be confident Job 6:20 ; 40:23 ; Prov 14:16 ; יִבְטַח כִּכְפִיר צַדִּיקִים the righteous are bold as a lion 28:1 ; secure Job 11:18 ; Prov 11:15 ; בֹּטֵחַ עַם a people secure Judg 18:7 , 10 , 27 ; בֹּטְחוֺת בָּנוֺת careless daughters ,, ( women ) Isa 32:9 compare 32:10 ; 32:11 . Hiph`il Perfect הִבְטַחְתָּ Jer 28:15 ; Imperfect יַבְטַח Isa 36:15 2 t.; Participle מַבְטִיחִי Psa 22:10 ; cause to trust, make secure , absolute 22:10 ; with עַל Jer 28:15 ; 29:31 ; with אֶל 2Kin 18:30 = Isa 36:15 .
